data.name: WeilerVR PPE Trainer
data.detailed_description:
WeilerVR: PPE Safety Trainer is a complete virtual reality training application centered on personal protective equipment (PPE) and workplace safety.

Key Features

  •  Full interactive training scenario – Learn correct PPE procedures in a realistic setting

  •  Hands-on interaction – Grab, equip, and apply protective gear

  •  Physics-based realism – Natural motion and tactile precision

  •  Educational focus – Reinforces awareness and decision-making

  •  Authentic environment – Modeled after real industrial locker rooms

Step into a realistic locker room where your task is to prepare a mannequin with the correct protective gear and task-specific gear. The experience emphasizes accuracy, awareness, and safe preparation practices.

Physics-based interaction and intuitive VR controls let users naturally engage with each item, reinforcing industrial safety standards.

Developed for Weiler Abrasives, this standalone experience demonstrates how VR can enhance training, reduce risk, and reinforce safety culture.
